items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: The interviewee discusses English drummers and Ken Collier's band in response to the interviewer's question about Robert Lewis, but does not mention any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge of Robert Lewis himself.
